about.heading: An advisory firm built around senior attention
about.body: AD Associates works with leadership teams facing decisions that do not have a clean answer. We are deliberately small, so the people you meet are the people who do the work. Every engagement is scoped to a question worth answering, and we would rather tell you the work is unnecessary than sell you a longer one.
emphasis: the people you meet are the people who do the work

capabilities.title: Strategy and growth
capabilities.description: Where to compete and what to stop doing. Market and competitor analysis, portfolio decisions, pricing, and growth plans that survive contact with a budget.

capabilities.title: Operations and performance
capabilities.description: Turning intent into throughput. Process and cost diagnostics, operating model design, and the unglamorous follow-through that makes a change stick past the first quarter.

capabilities.title: Transaction support
capabilities.description: Commercial and operational due diligence, valuation support, and post-deal integration planning — so the thesis you underwrote is the one you end up owning.

approach.heading: Small teams, senior people, direct answers
approach.body: We staff engagements thin and senior. You get a partner in the room rather than a pyramid of analysts, and findings as they emerge rather than a reveal in week eight. When the evidence contradicts the brief, we say so.
